summary: Rahul Verma from Northwind sent security documentation to David Thomas, the CISO at Kestrel Health, referencing Neha Kapoor’s note that David leads vendor security. David responded positively, noting it was the first vendor to provide such materials unprompted and agreed to a 30‑minute call on May 12. The next step is to hold the security call with Northwind’s security lead. No objections were raised in this exchange.

commitments.what: Schedule 30‑min security call with Northwind security lead

next_steps: Send calendar invite for May 12 security call
